name: Orchestra
title: getorchestra.com
shortDescription: Orchestra is a comprehensive platform designed to streamline the operations of digital agencies. It offers a white-labelled client portal where agencies can accept payments, manage tasks, and communicate with clients. An ideal tool for agencies specializing in productized services, Orchestra simplifies client interactions and agency management through a clean, fast user interface. Setup is quick, requiring only 5 minutes with no complicated steps, making it ready for use almost immediately.
cons: May not support all types of services
Dependent on third-party services like Stripe
